conclusions: Provider/select/listener arrangement does not add hundreds of milliseconds in this controlled same-core experiment.
Fresh TCP + two SOCKS authentications + TLS are meaningfully more expensive than a reused HTTPS connection.
Mihomo unified delay returns cold-path time when the HEAD target closes connections; current alive/history is still positive.
The HTTP forward-proxy attempts called warmHead-http do NOT reuse outbound server connections; treat them as repeated requests, not successful warm transport.
This does not reproduce the user's phone-vs-PC WAN comparison and cannot assign its root cause.
